name: ShulPress
author: srd2725

sections.description:
ShulPress turns any WordPress site into a full-featured synagogue website, with no account or subscription required. It brings your congregation’s essentials right into WordPress:

  • A single settings screen for your synagogue’s name, address, contact details, and website.
  • Live zmanim (halachic times) and Shabbat information for the ZIP code you configure, retrieved from the Hebcal API.
  • A Jewish calendar showing the current Hebrew date and the weekly Torah portion.

Everything is available as blocks, shortcodes, and widgets, so it works with both the block editor and classic themes.

Shortcodes

  • [shulpress_contact_info] — your configured synagogue contact information.
  • [shulpress_zmanim] — today’s zmanim for the configured location. Optional attributes: title, show_date, show_location.
  • Jewish calendar shortcodes for the Hebrew date, weekly Torah portion, and Shabbat card.

You can see the full list, with attributes, under ShulPress → Shortcode Reference in the admin.

ShulPress Pro

ShulPress Pro adds payments, membership, events, and a services calendar. Pro is an optional paid edition and is not required to use anything described above. Learn more at https://shulpress.dev.

External services

This plugin connects to the Hebcal API (https://www.hebcal.com) to retrieve zmanim, Shabbat times, and Jewish calendar data for the location you configure. This is required for the zmanim, Shabbat, and calendar features to function.

When a page containing one of those features is rendered, the plugin sends the ZIP code, timezone, and relevant date to Hebcal. No personal visitor data is sent, and responses are cached. If you do not configure a ZIP code and timezone, no request is made.

Hebcal’s terms of use: https://www.hebcal.com/home/about
Hebcal’s privacy policy: https://www.hebcal.com/home/privacy-policy

ShulPress also includes the Freemius SDK for optional usage tracking, licensing, secure checkout, and delivery of paid-edition updates. Freemius is contacted only after the administrator explicitly opts in or starts a purchase, trial, or license activation. Depending on the action, this may send the site URL, administrator contact details, plugin and WordPress versions, and license or purchase information.

Freemius terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
Freemius privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your site and activate it, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Go to ShulPress → Settings and enter your synagogue’s details, ZIP code, and timezone.
  3. Add the Contact Info and Zmanim blocks (or the [shulpress_contact_info] and [shulpress_zmanim] shortcodes) to any page or widget area.
sections.faq:
Where does the zmanim and calendar data come from?

From the Hebcal API (https://www.hebcal.com), based on the ZIP code and timezone you set in ShulPress settings. See the “External services” section above for details on what is sent.

Do I need ShulPress Pro?

No. Everything in the free plugin — settings, contact info, zmanim, and the Jewish calendar — works on its own. Pro is optional and adds payments, membership, events, and a services calendar.

The zmanim or calendar shows “temporarily unavailable.” What does that mean?

That usually means the Hebcal request failed or timed out, or the ZIP code and timezone have not been configured yet. Confirm both are set under ShulPress → Settings and try again.
sections.changelog:
0.2.0

  • Add optional ShulPress Pro features for payments, membership, events, and service scheduling.
  • Add Freemius-powered licensing, trials, checkout, and separate free and Pro packages.
  • Improve dashboard and settings layouts, including clearer setup guidance and streamlined account management.
  • Scope front-end styles to pages that render ShulPress content.
  • Strengthen form protection, release validation, and WordPress.org compatibility.

0.2.0-beta.6

  • fix bugs, remove # of plugins notice

0.2.0-beta.5

  • Scope frontend styles to pages that render ShulPress content.
  • Update release actions and remove reviewed Plugin Check warnings.

0.2.0-beta.4

  • Align automated WordPress deployment uploads with the current Freemius API contract.

0.2.0-beta.3

  • Download Freemius-generated packages directly into the release runner for validation and promotion.

0.2.0-beta.2

  • Fix automated collection and validation of Freemius-generated free and Pro packages.

0.2.0-beta.1

  • Consolidate the free and Pro editions into one Freemius-managed codebase.
  • Add licensed Pro delivery and automated validation of generated free and Pro packages.
  • Improve WordPress.org compatibility, security checks, release validation, and account navigation.

0.1.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release: synagogue settings, contact info, zmanim, and Jewish calendar via blocks, shortcodes, and widgets.
